_source: Which Census block equivalency file each state votes on in a cycle. Maps: U.S. Census Bureau Redistricting Data Office 119th- and 120th-Congress block equivalency files (https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/decennial/rdo/mapping-files/). Legal status per state: each state's enacting act or order (reasons below), cross-checked against Wikipedia's '2025–2026 United States redistricting' (read 2026-09-28); each official state block file available (TX, CA, FL, NC, OH) matches the Census CD120 file exactly. A hand-maintained record of legal facts (AGENTS.md 3a); edit it when a state's map or its legal status changes, then rerun backend/scripts/build_county_district_crosswalk.py and build_district_topology.py.
_use: One list, three readers: build_county_district_crosswalk.py and build_district_topology.py (which lines a state's counties and outlines come from), and live_results/sync.redrawn_states (which also drives the elections API's newDistrictLines, its cross-district incumbent match and the results payload's redrawnStates; a House seat in a state voting on a map other than the one its members were elected on — those going into the election, or the sitting Congress — has no knowable holder going into the election — the district of the same number is a different district — so no flip is announced against the old district's member; a cycle not listed keeps the newest earlier cycle's maps). A state never listed votes on its CD119 lines, and the crosswalk script refuses to build if its CD119 and CD120 blocks differ.

AL.reason: 2023 legislative plan (Act 2023-563) reinstated when the U.S. Supreme Court stayed the Allen v. Milligan injunction, 2026-06-02 (25A1314)

LA.reason: Legislature enacted a replacement map (Act 2, 2026 RS), 2026-05-29, after Louisiana v. Callais; the House votes in an open primary on Nov 3 (a majority wins the seat) with a Dec 12 runoff

MO.reason: 2025 map (in the Census CD120 file) stayed by the U.S. Supreme Court on 2026-09-25; the 2022 map stays in force for 2026

OH.reason: Ohio Redistricting Commission adopted a new map 2025-10-31

TX.reason: Legislature enacted plan PLANC2333 (2025-08-29); a district court injunction was stayed by the U.S. Supreme Court 2025-12-04

UT.reason: Court-adopted Map 1 (Third District Court, 2025-11-10) under the Proposition 4 litigation
